title: Activity partner finder
summary: Find a tennis partner, running buddy or board-game group at your level nearby.
whyTempting: Lots of people want to play but lack partners at the right level and time.
whyItFails: Liquidity per niche. Each sport × skill × suburb × time slot is a tiny market. No-shows. Unreliable strangers kill trust quickly. Clubs already solve it. Committed players join clubs; casual ones churn.
whatWouldChange: Partnering with venues/courts that already have the bookings and the players.

attempts.notes: Acquired by WeWork in 2017, sold to AlleyCorp in 2020 reportedly at a substantial loss, then to Bending Spoons in 2024.
A social discovery and networking platform designed to help people connect in real life (IRL) rather than just chatting online
